CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0010:
The number 16 brings to mind
Dragonite! It can fly in spite of its big
and bulky physique. It circles the globe
in just 16 hours.
CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0020:
You’ve collected 25 cards. 25 is
Pikachu’s National Pokédex
number! When several Pikachu
gather, their electricity can build
and cause lightning storms.
CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0030:
You’ve collected 50 cards. 50 is
Diglett’s National Pokédex number!
It lives about one yard underground,
where it feeds on plant roots. It
sometimes appears aboveground.
CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0040:
The number 80 brings to mind
Tentacruel! Its 80 tentacles can
stretch and shrink freely. Tentacruel
ensnares prey in a net of spread-out
tentacles, delivering venomous stings
to its catch.
CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0050:
The number 100 brings to mind
Machop! Its whole body is composed
of muscles. Even though it’s the size
of a human child, it can hurl 100
grown-ups.
CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0060:
The number 151 brings to mind the
Pokédex! A total of 151 Pokémon
were introduced in [Ctrl:Italic ]Pokémon Red[/Ctrl:Italic]
and [Ctrl:Italic ]Pokémon Blue[/Ctrl:Italic].
CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0070:
The number 180 brings to mind
Noctowl! When it needs to think, it
rotates its head 180 degrees to
sharpen its intellectual power.
CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0080:
You’ve collected 250 cards. 250 is
Ho-Oh’s National Pokédex
number! It will reveal itself before
a pure-hearted Trainer by shining
its bright, rainbow-colored wings.
CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0090:
The number 300 brings to mind
Florges! It is said that there was once
a Florges that protected the garden of
a castle for over 300 years.
CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0100:
The number 500 brings to mind
Spiritomb! It was bound to a fissure in
an odd keystone as punishment for
misdeeds 500 years ago.
CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0110:
You’ve collected 777 cards. 777 is
Togedemaru’s National Pokédex
number! When it’s in trouble, it
curls up into a ball, makes its fur
spikes stand on end, and then
discharges electricity indiscriminately.
CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0120:
The number 1,000 brings to mind
Jirachi! It is said to have the ability to
grant any wish for just one week
every thousand years.
CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0130:
The number 1,500 brings to mind
Gimmighoul! This Pokémon was born
inside a treasure chest about 1,500
years ago. It sucks the life-force out of
scoundrels who try to steal the
treasure.
CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0140:
The number 2,000 brings to mind
Conkeldurr! It is thought that
Conkeldurr taught humans how to
make concrete more than 2,000
years ago.
CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0150:
The number 5,000 brings to mind
Alakazam! It is said to have an IQ of
approximately 5,000. Its overflowing
psychokinetic powers cause headaches
to anyone nearby.
CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0160:
The number 10,000 brings to mind
Wartortle! It is said to live 10,000
years. Its furry tail is popular as a
symbol of longevity.
CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0170:
The number 15,000 brings to mind
Toxtricity! The jolts of electricity it
launches by violently strumming the
protrusions on its chest easily exceed
15,000 volts.
CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0180:
The number 20,000 brings to mind
Claydol! This mysterious Pokémon
started life as an ancient clay figurine
made over 20,000 years ago.
CardTotalMilestone_TIPS_0190:
The number 100,000 brings to mind
Raichu! It can loose 100,000-volt
bursts of electricity, instantly downing
foes several times its size.

FLAVOR_1:
There is a plant seed on its back right from the
day this Pokémon is born. The seed slowly
grows larger.

When the bulb on its back grows large, it
appears to lose the ability to stand on its
hind legs.

Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar
energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.
FLAVOR_4:
For protection, it releases a horrible stench from
the antenna on its head to drive away enemies.

It is waiting for the moment to evolve. At this
stage, it can only harden, so it remains
motionless to avoid attack.

In battle, it flaps its wings at great speed to
release highly toxic dust into the air.
FLAVOR_7:
Often found in forests and grasslands.
It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches
on top of its head.
FLAVOR_8:
Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only
harden its shell to protect itself when it is
in danger.
FLAVOR_9:
It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and
its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move.
It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.

Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor.

of 1.25 miles.

It has the world’s largest petals. With every step,

The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are

mushrooms, they tell it to bug off.

The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroom on
its back having become the main body. If the
mushroom comes off, the bug stops moving.

Poison oozes from all over its body. It catches
small bug Pokémon at night that are attracted
by light.

The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every
time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.

Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is

The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes.
It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.
FLAVOR_19:
Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles,
although no one has ever returned from there.

Though it may look like it’s just a bunch of eggs,

with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.
FLAVOR_21:
Each of Exeggutor’s three heads is thinking
different thoughts. The three don’t seem to be
very interested in one another.

Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows

Pokémon’s true appearance remains a mystery.
FLAVOR_23:
It slashes through grass with its sharp
scythes, moving too fast for the human
eye to track.

These Pokémon judge one another based on
pincers. Thicker, more impressive pincers make

It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself.
If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds,
it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.

It scatters cotton all over the place as a prank. If

The leaves on its head grow right back even if

The fragrance of the garland on its head has

difficult.

Until recently, people living in the mountains

It can sense the feelings of others by touching

It has a preference for hot things. When it rains,

It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it whips its

While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it

An ancient picture scroll shows that people

It can’t run properly when it’s newly born.

FLAVOR_1405:
When sunlight reflects on the ripples created by
a Bruxish grinding its teeth, the water all around
sparkles brilliantly.
FLAVOR_1406:
These Pokémon move in schools. They have an
electricity-generating organ, so they discharge
electricity if in danger.
FLAVOR_1407:
These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they
spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with
electricity.
FLAVOR_1408:
It latches on to prey with its sucker mouth,
sinking in its fangs and shocking the prey with
powerful electricity.
FLAVOR_1409:
As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over
the place and causes forest fires. It is
therefore disliked.
FLAVOR_1410:
On nights with a full moon, they gather together
and dance. The surrounding area is enveloped
in an abnormal magnetic field.
FLAVOR_1411:
It has an acute sense of hearing. It can easily hear
a pin being dropped nearly 1,100 yards away.
FLAVOR_1412:
It looks for a Mr. Rime that’s a good dancer
and carefully copies the Mr. Rime’s steps
like an apprentice.
FLAVOR_1413:
It’s known for its top-notch pantomime skills.
It protects itself from all sorts of attacks by
emitting auras from its fingers to create walls.
FLAVOR_1415:
Its cries echo inside its hollow body to emerge
as beautiful notes for startling and repelling foes.
FLAVOR_1416:
It tends to move in a pack with others.
They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.
FLAVOR_1417:
It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about,
searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.
FLAVOR_1418:
The auspicious shape of this Pokémon’s nose
apparently led some regions to consider
Swoobat a symbol of good luck.
FLAVOR_1419:
It gathers things it likes and passes them through
its loop to teleport them to a secret place.
FLAVOR_1420:
Anorith can swim swiftly by pulling its eight wings
through the water like oars on a boat. This
Pokémon is an ancestor of modern bug Pokémon.
FLAVOR_1421:
Though it lives on land, it’s also a good swimmer.
It dives into the ocean in search of prey, using its
sharp claws to take down its quarry.
FLAVOR_1422:
It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around.
It is close to evolving when it can handle heavy
lumber without difficulty.
FLAVOR_1423:
This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built
that even a group of wrestlers could not make it
budge an inch.
FLAVOR_1424:
Rather than rely on their strength, they master
moves that make good use of centrifugal force
to swing around concrete.
FLAVOR_1426:
When two of these Pokémon’s bodies are
combined together, new poisons are created.
FLAVOR_1427:
It’s so stinky! Muk’s body contains toxic
elements, and any plant will wilt when it
passes by.
FLAVOR_1428:
Poochyena pursue their prey in packs. Once the
prey is exhausted, the pack finishes it off. But
sometimes the prey retaliates, and the pack flees.
FLAVOR_1429:
Once it’s caught the scent of faraway prey,
the leader gives a signal, and the whole pack
moves out.
FLAVOR_1430:
Thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon,
it moves in zigzags and wreaks havoc upon
its surroundings.
FLAVOR_1431:
This very aggressive Pokémon will recklessly
challenge opponents stronger than itself.
FLAVOR_1432:
It evolved after experiencing numerous fights.
While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that
would make any opponent flinch.
FLAVOR_1433:
It has a small heart and brain. Its stomach
comprises most of its body, with enzymes to
dissolve anything.
FLAVOR_1434:
It can swallow a tire whole in one gulp. It secretes
a horribly toxic fluid from the pores on its body.
FLAVOR_1435:
Since the feathers that it sheds are thin and
sharp, people apparently once used them
as swords.
FLAVOR_1436:
It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are
actually steel horns that have been transformed.
FLAVOR_1437:
All its cells are magnets. It communicates with
others of its kind by transmitting magnetic forces
from its body.
FLAVOR_1438:
It adores magnetic minerals, so it pursues
Nosepass at speeds exceeding 60 mph.
FLAVOR_1439:
It firmly pins its prey using its four claws and
large body. Then Metagross uses the mouth
on its stomach to chew its prey to bits.
FLAVOR_1440:
These Pokémon evolve by wearing the shell
covering of a Shelmet. The steel armor protects
their whole body.
FLAVOR_1441:
Its metal body is durable but prone to
retaining heat. It vents this heat from the
slits in its tail.
FLAVOR_1442:
It digs holes on mountains, searching for food.
It’s so durable that being caught in a cave-in
won’t faze it.
FLAVOR_1443:
It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky.
Until recently, no one had ever seen it.
FLAVOR_1444:
Noibat can change the frequency of its sound
waves at will, and it generates ultrasonic waves of
up to 200,000 hertz.
FLAVOR_1445:
In the dark, even Hydreigon are terrified of this
Pokémon. But in the light, Noivern is the one that
avoids battle.
FLAVOR_1446:
Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until
it’s angered. When that happens, it stirs up a
gale and flattens everything around.
FLAVOR_1447:
The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm,
while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two
share one apple and help each other out.
FLAVOR_1448:
These capricious syrpents have banded together.
On the rare occasion that their moods align,
their true power is unleashed.
FLAVOR_1449:
This Pokémon is common but hazardous. Its
sharp incisors can easily cut right through
hard wood.
FLAVOR_1450:
Its whiskers are essential for maintaining its
balance. No matter how friendly you are, it will
get angry and bite you if you touch its whiskers.
FLAVOR_1451:
Its tail moves with greater dexterity than its
hands. Making deft use of this tail, Aipom lives
high among the treetops.
FLAVOR_1452:
Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling and
doing things that Ambipom rarely uses its hands.
FLAVOR_1453:
It changes color to blend in with its surroundings
in order to sneak up on prey. It can’t make its
belly pattern disappear, however.
FLAVOR_1454:
It’s forgetful and not very bright, but many
Trainers love it anyway for its friendliness
and sincerity.
FLAVOR_1455:
These bright Pokémon have acute memories.
Apparently delivery workers often choose them
as their partners.
FLAVOR_1456:
This Pokémon is intelligent and intensely proud.
People will sit up and take notice if you become
the Trainer of one.
FLAVOR_1457:
It strengthens its body by diving into the depths
of ponds, swimming around while looking for
bog moss to eat.
FLAVOR_1458:
Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer,
but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.
FLAVOR_1459:
It was modeled after a mighty Pokémon of myth.
The mask placed upon it limits its power in order
to keep it under control.
FLAVOR_1460:
The final factor needed to release this
Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond
with a Trainer it trusts.
FLAVOR_1461:
The research efforts of a certain scientist
ultimately resulted in this Pokémon.
Its powers are dedicated to battling.
FLAVOR_1462:
It rides upon ocean winds as if it were a
glider. In the winter, it hides food around
its nest.
FLAVOR_1463:
When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its
mother fused to it. Marowak’s temperament also
turned vicious at the same time.
FLAVOR_1464:
It nests in horizontal holes warmed by geothermal
heat. Foes who get too close can expect to be
pounced on and bitten.
FLAVOR_1465:
It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in
caves and hoards the loot in its nest.
FLAVOR_1466:
Twigs make for Fennekin’s snacks. When it
nibbles on twigs, it finds the courage to face
strong foes.
FLAVOR_1467:
The eyeball patterns on the interior of its ears
emit psychic energy. It keeps the patterns tightly
covered because that power is too immense.
FLAVOR_1468:
It prefers to avoid groups. In its day-to-day life,
it dexterously controls its vines to compensate
for its short arms.
FLAVOR_1469:
Servine’s one weakness is its inflated sense of
pride. It takes a while for Servine to be able to
cooperate with other Pokémon.
FLAVOR_1470:
An intimidating gaze and majestic appearance
have caused this Pokémon to be known as the
Lord of the Forest.
FLAVOR_1471:
Braixen’s branch ignites as it’s pulled from the
Pokémon’s tail. Braixen then uses the flame to
spark powerful attacks.
FLAVOR_1472:
It controls flames telekinetically, trapping its
foes in a fiery vortex surpassing 5,400 degrees
Fahrenheit and burning them to a crisp.
FLAVOR_1473:
It protects its young in its beak. It bobs on
waves, resting on them on days when the waters
are calm.
FLAVOR_1474:
Its ecology is starkly different from that of other
Basculin, so theories that it’s a totally different
species have gained traction in recent years.
FLAVOR_1475:
It can jump with incredible power. Parts of its
body are tinged red by the rage of its fallen
friends.
FLAVOR_1476:
It’s usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken
for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.
FLAVOR_1477:
It explodes in response to even minor stimuli.
It is feared, with the nickname of the Bomb Ball.
FLAVOR_1478:
This Pokémon prefers places with lots of lightning
strikes. It catches lightning with its mane and
stores the electricity within its body.
FLAVOR_1479:
Once the herd hears thunder, it chases after the
storm clouds so that the Blitzle in the group can
use the lightning to charge up.
FLAVOR_1480:
This Pokémon is so timid that even brushing
against seaweed will make it discharge electricity
in surprise. Its lips do not conduct electricity.
FLAVOR_1481:
When they sense danger, they exert their psychic
power at its maximum output. They have no
regard for their opponents.
FLAVOR_1482:
This Pokémon lives quietly in the depths of the
forest. The purple, cape-like fur gets longer
and longer as Oranguru ages.
FLAVOR_1483:
From the forces of lightning and wind, it creates
energy to give nutrients to the soil and make the
land abundant.
FLAVOR_1484:
A very common sight in grasslands and such.
It flicks its tongue in and out to sense danger
in its surroundings.
FLAVOR_1485:
This Pokémon is very tenacious. Once it targets
its prey, it won’t give up the chase, no matter
how far the prey goes.
FLAVOR_1486:
The poisonous gases it contains are a little bit
lighter than air. That’s why it’s always slightly
airborne.
FLAVOR_1487:
When it’s in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes
its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges
electricity indiscriminately.
FLAVOR_1488:
It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins.
Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin
after coin at them in quick succession.
FLAVOR_1489:
The protuberances on its head serve as
sensors. It can even detect distant prey.
FLAVOR_1490:
Its body is composed of crystallized dragon
energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of
every dragon Pokémon.
FLAVOR_1491:
With their strong capacity for survival, they can
live in dirty places without concern. Left
unchecked, their numbers multiply rapidly.
FLAVOR_1492:
It carefully carries a round, white rock that it thinks
is an egg. It’s bothered by how curly its hair looks.
FLAVOR_1493:
Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer,
but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.
FLAVOR_1494:
This is a meticulous Pokémon that likes to keep
things tidy. It shrouds itself in a floral aroma that
soothes the Pokémon around it.
FLAVOR_1496:
The spines sprouting from its head are
transformed fangs. If they’re injured or broken
off, the spines will regenerate countless times.
FLAVOR_1502:
Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate
others. It once used its powers to force people
and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.
FLAVOR_1503:
Massive amounts of energy intensely stimulated
Ampharos’s cells, apparently awakening its
long-sleeping dragon’s blood.
FLAVOR_1504:
With its muscular strength now greatly
increased, it can fly continuously for two weeks
without resting.
FLAVOR_1505:
Its down is so soft, it seems as if a touch could
melt it. But it’s strong enough that just a few
strands could be used to hoist a dump truck.
FLAVOR_1557:
In order to support its flower, which has grown
larger due to Mega Evolution, its back and legs
have become stronger.
FLAVOR_1558:
Its bond with its Trainer is the source of
its power. It boasts speed and maneuverability
greater than that of a jet.
FLAVOR_1559:
The cannon on its back is as powerful as a
tank gun. Its tough legs and back enable it to
withstand the recoil from firing the cannon.
FLAVOR_1560:
It swings its ears like whips and strikes its
enemies with them. It has an intensely
combative disposition.
FLAVOR_1561:
To protect itself from opponents’ attacks, it uses
magnetism to control pieces of its hard outer
shell that have flaked off.
FLAVOR_1562:
When it opens the red plate on its chest and
unleashes its heart, its strongest psychic power
is released.
FLAVOR_1563:
Its two sets of jaws thrash about violently as if
they each had a will of their own. One gnash from
them can turn a boulder to dust.
FLAVOR_1564:
Thanks to Mega Evolution, its mental power is
limitless. It conjures up arms imbued with malice
to defeat its enemies.
FLAVOR_1565:
The overwhelming power that fills its entire body
causes it to turn black and creates intense
blue flames.
FLAVOR_1566:
When bathed in the energy of Mega Evolution,
Shellder converts into impregnable armor. There
is virtually no change in Slowpoke.
FLAVOR_1567:
Mega Evolution fills its body with a tremendous
amount of electricity, but it’s too much for
Manectric to fully control.
FLAVOR_1568:
It can pass through other dimensions and appear
anywhere. It caused a stir one time when it stuck
just one leg out of a wall.
FLAVOR_1569:
Due to the effects of Mega Evolution, its pincers
have taken on a more diabolical form, ripping
anything they pinch to shreds.
FLAVOR_1570:
When this Pokémon’s rage reaches a boiling
point, the huge volcano in the hump on its back
erupts violently, spewing molten lava.
FLAVOR_1571:
Anyone who touches the secondary feelers that
have sprouted from the base of its throat will fall
into a deep sleep.
FLAVOR_1572:
It can grip things with its two horns and
lift 500 times its own body weight.
FLAVOR_1573:
This Pokémon is also known as the Royal
Pink Princess. The dazzling, sparkling diamond
on its forehead is a whopping 2,000 carats.
FLAVOR_1574:
It gets power from the bond it has with its Trainer.
Mega Evolution has given it plates to slice its
enemies and a cape to protect its body.
FLAVOR_1575:
This form results from
one Metagross, one Metang,
and two Beldum linking up.
FLAVOR_1576:
Houndoom’s entire body generates heat when it
Mega Evolves. Its intense, fiery breath turns its
opponents to charcoal.
FLAVOR_1577:
Its disposition is more vicious than before its
Mega Evolution. Garchomp carves its opponents
up with the scythes on both arms.
FLAVOR_1628:
It feeds on dust in the atmosphere. The color
of its core is said to be determined by the
composition of the dust it eats.
FLAVOR_1777:
A shooting star streaking across the night sky
may, in fact, be Mega Rayquaza flying gracefully
after a meteoroid.
